summary: 10.0.34.16 Enterprise Release - User Access & Permissions Desktop Parity, Dynamic Role Lookups, Dedicated Registration Approvals & Permission Matrix, Supplier Import Persistence, Footer Spacing, and Report Scheduler
highlights: 1. Desktop Parity 10-Column User Access Table: Full alignment with UserAccess.fxml containing User, Email / Username, Role, Department, Access, Branch, Status, Last Login, MFA, and Actions dropdown menu (.btn-purple) with 7 actions + delete.
2. Dynamic Server-Owned Role Lookups: Real roles fetched from GET /api/admin/roles populating all filter, dialog, approval, and permission dropdowns without mock data.

3. Add vs Edit User Account Modal Parity: Password mandatory on Add User, optional on Edit User ('Leave blank to keep current password') preserving password on empty submission, with eye visibility toggles, MFA policy, and Authenticator reset.
4. Dedicated Registration Approvals Workspace: Full-screen #view-registration-approvals with 2 KPI cards, applicant queue table, final role assignment, and Approve/Reject controls.
5. Manage Roles Master Data Delegation: Navigates to Masters workspace and automatically activates category 'ROLE'.

6. Permission Matrix Workspace: 31 modules across 10 categories replicating PermissionCatalog.java, common capabilities, special capabilities with compact N/M dropdowns, 4 templates, copy from role, search, granted-only filter, dynamic effective preview, and optimistic locking save.
7. Data Import Supplier Upsert Persistence: Preserved existing party ID and rowVersion in ImportService.js to resolve 'Party id is required' server error during supplier imports.
8. Universal Application Footer Spacing: Upgraded .app-footer-bar to 38px height with generous gaps, paddings, and alignment matching desktop SharedApplicationFooter.java.
9. Report Scheduler Tab Fix: Correctly parsed res.schedules and bound 4 KPI summary cards from ReportScheduleDtos.SchedulePage.
